Tonight the Sun and Moon share a warm glance.

The Sun squares Mars around lunchtime, a tense angle, and makes a friendly trine to the Moon in Pisces tonight. Swipe for Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Earth friend. 🌙
